blocks.text: Former model Deniece Cornejo is set to be released from detention after the Court of Appeals ordered her immediate release in connection with the serious illegal detention case filed by actor and television host Vhong Navarro. In a decision dated Sept. 25, the Court of Appeals ordered the immediate release of Cornejo unless there is another lawful reason to keep her detained. It is directed to the director general of the NBP-BuCor in Muntinlupa City and the superintendent of the Correctional Institution for Women in Mandaluyong City.
